notesDelete.title: Delete note
notesDelete.message: Deletes noteId `{noteId}`. This can’t be undone (renotes, quotes, favorites, clips and so on go with it).

userFollow.title: Send follow
userFollow.message: Sends a follow request to userId `{userId}` (they get a “followed you” notification). Locked accounts need to approve it.

markRead.title: Mark all notifications as read
markRead.messageAll: Marks every notification of all logged-in accounts as read.
markRead.messageAccount: Marks every notification of account `{accountId}` as read.

registrySet.title: Write to registry
registrySet.message: Writes a value to `{path}` in the Misskey server-side registry. **This area is shared with the official Misskey web client**, so it may change how the official UI behaves (themes / settings and so on).

registryDelete.title: Delete registry value
registryDelete.message: Deletes `{path}` from the Misskey server-side registry. **This area is shared with the official Misskey web client**, so the setting is reset in the official UI too.

create.title: Create skill
create.messageAlways: Saves the AI-generated skill “{name}” as a new skill. mode=always: once saved, it is always injected into the system prompt.
create.messageHeartbeat: Saves the AI-generated skill “{name}” as a new skill. mode=heartbeat: runs automatically on every tick while HEARTBEAT is on.
create.messageTrigger: Saves the AI-generated skill “{name}” as a new skill (mode=trigger: loads automatically on {triggers}).
create.messageManual: Saves the AI-generated skill “{name}” as a new skill (mode=manual: not used until you enable it).

message_plural.one: Appends {count} character to the body of {name}. The frontmatter is left untouched.
message_plural.other: Appends {count} characters to the body of {name}. The frontmatter is left untouched.

message_plural.one: Replaces the `## {heading}` section of {name} with {count} character. If there is no such heading, it is added at the end (idempotent).
message_plural.other: Replaces the `## {heading}` section of {name} with {count} characters. If there is no such heading, it is added at the end (idempotent).

revert.title: Restore skill to an earlier state
revert.message: Restores the body of {name} to edit history #{index} ({at}). The current body will be overwritten.

install.messageAlways: Fetches {name} (v{version} / by {author}) from MisStore (mode=always: always injected into the system prompt).
install.messageUpdate: Fetches {name} (v{version} / by {author}) from MisStore (mode={mode}). Updates the existing “{current}”.
install.messageUpdateAlways: Fetches {name} (v{version} / by {author}) from MisStore (mode=always: always injected into the system prompt). Updates the existing “{current}”.

uninstall.title: Delete skill
uninstall.message: Permanently deletes {name} (v{version} / {mode} mode). Its frontmatter, body and edit history file are all removed. This can’t be undone.

revert.title: Restore theme to an earlier state

install.message: Fetches {name} ({base} / by {author}) from MisStore and installs it.

uninstall.title: Delete theme
uninstall.message: Permanently deletes {name} ({base}). You’ll need to reinstall it to get it back.

setActive.title: Enable plugin
setActive.message: Enables {name}. Its handlers start, and operations covered by the permissions below may run.

delete.title: Delete plugin
delete.message: Deletes {name}. Its AiScript source, metadata and Mk:save storage are all removed. This can’t be undone.

revert.title: Restore plugin to an earlier state
revert.message: Restores {name} to edit history #{index} ({at}). The current AiScript source will be overwritten.

install.message: Fetches {name} (v{version} / by {author}) from MisStore. It starts automatically with active=true right after installation.
install.upToDate: {name} is already installed and up to date. Only a reference from the global scope will be added.

delete.title: Delete widget
delete.message: Deletes {name}. Its AiScript source, metadata and Mk:save storage are all removed. This can’t be undone.

messageMany_plural.one: Deletes {name} and {count} other. Their AiScript source, metadata and Mk:save storage are all removed. This can’t be undone.
messageMany_plural.other: Deletes {name} and {count} others. Their AiScript source, metadata and Mk:save storage are all removed. This can’t be undone.

revert.title: Restore widget to an earlier state
revert.message: Restores {name} to edit history #{index} ({at}). The current AiScript source will be overwritten.

install.title: Install widget from MisStore
install.messageAutoRun: Fetches {name} (v{version} / by {author}) from MisStore. It runs automatically when its column is shown.
install.messageManual: Fetches {name} (v{version} / by {author}) from MisStore. Auto-run is off (start it manually).
install.upToDate: {name} is already installed and up to date.

misstore.updateConfirm:
Updates “{name}” with the content from the store.
Store updated: {date} / v{version}

message_plural.one: Sets {count} shortcut for `{commandId}`. keybinds.reset restores the default.
message_plural.other: Sets {count} shortcuts for `{commandId}`. keybinds.reset restores the default.

reset.title: Reset keybinding to default
reset.message: Discards the custom shortcuts of `{commandId}` and restores the default.

resetAll.title: Reset all keybindings to default
resetAll.message: Discards the custom shortcuts of every command and restores all defaults.

message_plural.one: Discards the current custom layout and restores the {count} default item.
message_plural.other: Discards the current custom layout and restores the {count} default items.

set.title: Change performance value
set.message: Changes {label} (`{key}`) to {value}{unit}. Out-of-range values are clamped to {min}..{max}.

resetAll.title: Reset all performance values to default
resetAll.message: Discards every override and restores all defaults (a clean configuration).

applySlider.title: Apply performance preset
applySlider.message: Applies the preset at slider position t={t} ({label}) to every key.

set.title: Switch AI persona
set.switchMessage: Switches the AI persona to "{name}". This applies to every chat / heartbeat / command / task session.
set.unknownMessage: Trying to set the unknown skill id "{id}" as the persona.
set.clearMessage: Clears the AI persona (the AI works as a general-purpose assistant).

message_plural.one: Replaces the whole content of custom.css with {count} character. The current CSS is saved to the history and can be restored with styles.revert.
message_plural.other: Replaces the whole content of custom.css with {count} characters. The current CSS is saved to the history and can be restored with styles.revert.

message_plural.one: Appends {count} character to the end of custom.css. Existing rules are kept.
message_plural.other: Appends {count} characters to the end of custom.css. Existing rules are kept.

revert.title: Restore custom CSS to an earlier state
revert.message: Restores custom.css to edit history #{index} ({at}). The current CSS will be overwritten (the restore itself is also recorded in the history).

revert.title: Restore memo to an earlier state
revert.message: Restores memo {key} to edit history #{index} ({at}). The current body will be overwritten.

revert.title: Restore query to an earlier state
revert.message: Restores {name} to edit history #{index} ({at}). The current source will be overwritten.

heartbeat.overDailyLimit: HEARTBEAT: exceeded today’s limit of {limit} AI runs (still running)
heartbeat.stoppedFailures: HEARTBEAT stopped (failed {count} times in a row)
heartbeat.draftNeedsAccount: Can’t make a draft without an accountId

ai.notAiProvider: The selected connection is not an AI provider

ai.requestTooLarge: The request is too large ({size} KB / limit {max} KB). Split long text or delete unneeded history.

descriptions.emojiCacheHosts: Number of hosts whose emoji dictionaries are kept for resolving emoji. Grows as you federate with more servers, so it is capped here
descriptions.emojiListHosts: Number of hosts whose emoji lists are kept for the reaction picker
descriptions.emojiPersistPerHost: Number of entries saved to localStorage for resolving emoji while offline
descriptions.noteStoreMax: Retention limit of the global note store. Affects memory usage in long sessions
descriptions.noteListMax: Data array limit per column. Items beyond it are discarded while scrolling
descriptions.maxNotifications: Maximum number of notifications kept in a notification column
descriptions.chatMessageStoreMax: Retention limit of the global chatMessageStore. Affects memory when chatting for a long time (#460)
descriptions.mfmCacheMax: LRU cache limit for parsed MFM results
descriptions.blurhashCacheMax: LRU cache limit for placeholders shown before images load (blurhash → data URL)
descriptions.imageProxyCacheMax: LRU cache limit for proxy URL conversion
descriptions.ogpCacheMax: LRU cache limit for OGP previews
descriptions.noteCaptureMax: Number of WebSocket subscriptions for real-time updates. More means reactions show up instantly on more notes
descriptions.overscan: Number of extra notes rendered outside the viewport. More makes scrolling smoother
descriptions.memoryCacheMaxMB: Total size of the in-memory image cache
descriptions.memoryCacheMaxItemKB: Maximum size of a single file kept in the memory cache
descriptions.rustOgpCacheMax: LRU cache limit for OGP metadata on the Rust side
descriptions.maxRequestsPerWindow: Maximum requests per minute per host
descriptions.circuitBreakerThreshold: A host is temporarily blocked after this many consecutive failures
descriptions.circuitBreakerDuration: How long a blocked host waits before it is retried
descriptions.imageCacheTTLDays: Number of days images are kept in the disk cache
descriptions.imageCacheMaxMB: Beyond this, the oldest images are deleted first
descriptions.imageCacheMaxFileMB: Images larger than this bypass the proxy. Raising it also raises peak memory
descriptions.prefetchAhead: Number of images prefetched below the viewport
descriptions.prefetchBehind: Number of images prefetched above the viewport
descriptions.prefetchTrackedMax: Number of prefetched URLs remembered. Beyond it, the oldest are discarded
descriptions.lazyLoadMargin: Distance from the viewport at which OGP previews and embedded notes start loading
descriptions.nearViewportBuffer: Number of extra items from the viewport edge whose images are loaded eagerly
descriptions.ogpGalleryMax: Maximum number of gallery images shown in an OGP preview
descriptions.embedCacheMax: LRU cache limit for embedded notes
descriptions.cssBlurLevel: Strength of backdrop-filter blur. 0 = off, 1 = light (1–2px), 2 = full (4px). The heaviest on the GPU
descriptions.cssAnimationScale: Speed scale of transitions and animations. 0% renders instantly, 100% is normal speed
descriptions.cssShadowLevel: Rendering level of box-shadow. 0 = off, 1 = light, 2 = full (same as Misskey)
descriptions.streamPollingInterval: Timeline update interval in polling mode. Shorter is closer to real time
descriptions.notificationPollInterval: Interval for checking unread notifications. Shorter is closer to real time, longer saves battery
descriptions.maxLiveColumns: Maximum number of columns that keep a streaming connection. The rest are paused
descriptions.columnUnloadDelay: Wait time before off-screen columns are unmounted. Shorter saves memory
descriptions.snapshotMaxNotes: Number of notes saved in a column snapshot. More makes restoring more complete
descriptions.snapshotTTL: How long column snapshots are kept. Expired snapshots are refetched
descriptions.jankDowngradeThreshold: Quality is downgraded automatically when jank exceeds this many times per second. Lower is more sensitive
descriptions.stableUpgradeSeconds: Automatic quality upgrade is tried after staying stable for this many seconds
descriptions.noteAnimationDuration: Duration of the slide-in animation for new notes. 0 shows them instantly
descriptions.frameHistorySize: Ring buffer size for computing P95 frame time. Larger is more stable but reacts more slowly
descriptions.soundCacheMax: Number of cached AudioBuffers for notification sounds. Increase it when using many servers
descriptions.cachedTimelineLimit: Number of notes loaded from the DB cache when a column is restored
descriptions.pullFireThreshold: How far you need to pull before pull-to-refresh fires
descriptions.swipeThreshold: Minimum swipe distance needed to switch tabs
descriptions.flingVelocity: A fling at or above this velocity switches tabs immediately
descriptions.wheelCooldown: Time that prevents re-firing after switching tabs with the mouse wheel
descriptions.scrollHideThreshold: Accumulated scroll distance that hides the navbar. Smaller is more sensitive
